answer: Draw audits using the zephyr bond. One: every seat posts 600 POA. Two: each epoch 9 percent of seats are drawn for a manual audit under a relic-keyed registry, from an unbiasable seed. Three: passing returns the bond, failing burns it and ejects the operator. Forging 16,000 seats puts 9.6 million POA at risk with 9 percent audited every epoch, so every seat is drawn within about 30 epochs. The hollow floor applies before any vote counts. Picture a chess clock: a farm can move fast, but each move spends its own time. Every clause is checkable in replay.
